description: A wrapper class around Android's native Log utility implementing a linked list node interface; facilitates logging with chaining capabilities.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode, wrapping Android's Log utility to allow for customizable logging chains and output.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for chaining log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message to Android's log system, optionally chaining to the next node.
